answer: Require every new identity to earn standing through a slow, public apprenticeship. Each agent starts on a narrow ledge: it may only do small, low-value tasks, and each completed task is recorded in a public ledger that other agents can mirror and check. Standing grows only with consistent, correct work over weeks, and it cannot be transferred or bought. An attacker who wants a plume of fake identities must therefore pay the full time and compute cost for each one, doing real work for each, making a large sybil swarm more expensive than the rewards it could steal.
